method: Market cap = shares outstanding x Twelve Data close on one common date. Shares: SEC EDGAR XBRL, the freshest (<= 200 days) of dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding (10-K/10-Q cover, all classes summed), us-gaap CommonStockSharesOutstanding, diluted then basic weighted-average shares; for the few companies with none (typically multi-class), an estimate = SEC public float / close on the float date (shares_basis=public_float_proxy). Candidates were pre-selected as the 300 largest by SEC dei:EntityPublicFloat (so only they need a price); the final ranking is by market cap.
sources: Wikipedia List of S&P 500 companies (CC BY-SA 4.0)
